name: THE HOOK
spoken: Your employer will double your money. Most people never take it.

name: THE TURN
spoken: It's the 401k match. Put money in, they match it. A guaranteed hundred percent. Your bank pays zero point zero one.

name: STEP ONE
spoken: Step one. Check your plan. A typical match is four to six percent of your salary.

name: THE NUMBERS
spoken: Sixty thousand a year? The match pays twenty-four hundred. Free.

name: THE ESCALATION
spoken: Skip it for ten years and thirty-eight thousand is gone. Forty? The match alone passes a million.

name: THE PAYOFF
spoken: The only free money in finance. Check your plan today. And save this for someone leaving theirs.
